questions.hi: किसी डेटाबेस से सूचना को निकालने के लिए निम्नांकित में से किस SQL कमांड का प्रयोग किया जाता है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Querying/Retrieving data = `SELECT`; Creating tables = `CREATE`; Removing tables = `DROP`.

questions.en: Which of the following SQL commands is used to modify the structure of a table?
questions.hi: निम्नांकित में से किस SQL कमांड का प्रयोग किसी टेबल के स्ट्रक्चर को बदलने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: `ALTER TABLE` alters table structure (DDL); `UPDATE` alters table rows/content (DML).

questions.en: Which of the following SQL keywords is used to display data from a table based on certain pattern?
questions.hi: निम्नांकित में से किस SQL कीवर्ड का प्रयोग किसी पैटर्न पर आधारित टेबल से डेटा को दर्शाने के लिए होता है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Pattern matching = `LIKE` (`%` and `_`); Membership check = `IN`; Range check = `BETWEEN`.

questions.en: Degree and cardinality of a relation in relational database are 4 and 3 respectively. If 3 attributes and 4 tuples are added to the relation, what will be its new cardinality and degree?
questions.hi: रिलेशनल डेटा बेस में एक रिलेशन का डिग्री और कार्डिनलिटी क्रमशः 4 और 3 हैं। अगर 3 ऐट्रिब्यूट और 4 ट्यूपल उस रिलेशन में जोड़ दिया जाए, तो उस रिलेशन का नया कार्डिनलिटी और डिग्री क्या होगा?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Degree = Attributes (4+3=7); Cardinality = Tuples (3+4=7). Result = 7, 7.

questions.en: Which SQL command is used to remove a table from a database?
questions.hi: किसी डेटाबेस से टेबल को हटाने के लिए किस SQL कमांड का प्रयोग किया जाता है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Remove table schema completely = `DROP TABLE`; Remove all rows but preserve schema = `TRUNCATE` or `DELETE`.

questions.en: The register that contains the address of the next instruction to be executed is called
questions.hi: वह रजिस्टर, जिसमें अगला इन्सट्रक्शन जो एक्जिक्यूट होने वाला होता है उसका ऐड्रेस होता है, कहलाता है
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Next instruction address = Program Counter (PC); Current instruction opcode = Instruction Register (IR).

questions.en: The register that contains the instruction that is being executed is called
questions.hi: एक्जिक्यूट हो रहे इन्सट्रक्शन को रखनेवाले रजिस्टर को कहा जाता है
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Address of instruction = Program Counter (PC); Body of executing instruction = Instruction Register (IR).

questions.en: The register which holds the address of location of memory to and from which data are to be transferred is known as
questions.hi: वह रजिस्टर, जिसमें मेमोरी के स्थान का पता होता है जहाँ से या जहाँ तक डेटा स्थानांतरित किया जाना होता है, कहलाता है
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Address holding register = MAR (Memory Address Register); Data holding register = MBR/MDR (Memory Buffer/Data Register).

questions.en: A storage device used to compensate the difference in flow of data is known as
questions.hi: डेटा के प्रवाह में अंतर की भरपाई के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली स्टोरेज डिवाइस को क्या कहा जाता है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Speed compensation / Flow rate mismatch = Buffer; Rapid cache lookup = Cache Memory.

questions.en: Memory in which any location can be reached in a fixed amount of time after specifying its address is called
questions.hi: वह मेमोरी, जिसके किसी लोकेशन पर उस लोकेशन को बताने के बाद एक निश्चित समय में पहुँचा जा सकता है, कहलाती है
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Uniform fixed access time regardless of address = Random Access Memory (RAM); Sequential search = Magnetic Tape.

questions.en: If (X567)_8 + (2YX5)_8 = (71YX)_8, then the values of X and Y are(
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Octal addition: Convert sum to decimal, divide by 8; remainder is current digit, quotient is carry. 7 + 5 = 12_10 = (1 * 8 + 4) -> digit 4, carry 1 -> X = 4.

questions.en: The range of the numbers that can be represented in 8-bit using 2's complement representation is
questions.hi: 2's कॉम्प्लिमेन्ट रिप्रेजेन्टेशन का प्रयोग करके 8 बिट में रिप्रेजेन्ट होने वाली संख्याओं का रेन्ज है
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: 2's complement range formula: -2^(n-1) to +2^(n-1)-1. For 8 bits: -128 to +127. For 16 bits: -32768 to +32767.

questions.en: If (11X1Y)_8 = (12C9)_16, then the values of X and Y are(
questions.hi: अगर (11X1Y)_8 = (12C9)_16 हो, तो X और Y के मान हैं)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Hex to Octal bridge: Convert Hex to 4-bit binary, regroup binary into 3-bit clusters from right to left.

questions.en: Which of the following 4-bit numbers equals its 2's complement?
questions.hi: निम्नांकित 4-बिट नम्बरों में से कौन-सा अपने 2's कॉम्प्लिमेन्ट के बराबर है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: The most negative number in 2's complement (1 followed by all zeros) always equals its own 2's complement.

questions.en: The number of 1's in the binary representation of the value of the decimal expression of 16^3 * 9 + 16^2 * 7 + 16 * 5 + 3 is
questions.hi: डेसिमल एक्सप्रेशन 16^3 * 9 + 16^2 * 7 + 16 * 5 + 3 के मान को बाइनरी रिप्रेजेन्टेशन में बदलने पर 1 की संख्या कितनी होगी?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Powers of 16 form hexadecimal positional notation: (9753)_16. Sum the 1-bits of each hex digit: 2 + 3 + 2 + 2 = 9.

questions.en: The Boolean expression x + x'y equals
questions.hi: बूलियन एक्सप्रेशन x + x'y बराबर है
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Absorption & Redundancy rule: `A + A'B = A + B`.

questions.en: The Boolean expression AB + AB' + A'C + AC is independent of Boolean variable
questions.hi: बूलियन एक्सप्रेशन AB + AB' + A'C + AC बूलियन वैरिएबल _____ पर निर्भर नहीं है।
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Factor out common terms: A(B+B') + C(A'+A) = A(1) + C(1) = A + C. This is independent of B.

questions.en: The Boolean expression A + BC equals
questions.hi: बूलियन एक्सप्रेशन A + BC के बराबर है
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Distributive laws: A(B + C) = AB + AC, and A + BC = (A + B)(A + C).

questions.en: The Boolean expression x + xy will be equal to
questions.hi: बूलियन एक्सप्रेशन x + xy के बराबर होगा
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Boolean Absorption Law: `x + xy = x`.

questions.en: The Boolean expression x(x + y) is equal to(
questions.hi: बूलियन एक्सप्रेशन x(x + y) बराबर है)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Dual Absorption Law: `x(x + y) = x`.

questions.en: If x is a Boolean variable, then (((x')')')' will be(
questions.hi: अगर x बूलियन वैरिएबल है, तो (((x')')')' होगा)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Even number of complement primes = variable itself (x); Odd number of complement primes = negated variable (x'). 4 is even \rightarrow x.

questions.en: In two-valued Boolean algebra, the maximum number of Boolean functions for two variables will be
questions.hi: दो मान वाले बूलियन अलजेब्रा में 2 वैरिएबलों के लिए अधिकतम बूलियन फंक्शन की संख्या होगी
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Number of distinct Boolean functions of n variables = 2^(2^n). For 1 variable = 4; for 2 variables = 16; for 3 variables = 256.

questions.en: Simplified Boolean function of Boolean function F = A'C + A'B + AB'C + BC is
questions.hi: बूलियन फंक्शन F = A'C + A'B + AB'C + BC का सरलीकृत बूलियन फंक्शन है
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Group C terms: (A' + AB' + B)C = C. Combine with remaining term to get F = C + A'B.

questions.en: Which of the following logic gates is called universal gate?
questions.hi: निम्नांकित में से कौन-सा लॉजिक गेट, यूनिवर्सल गेट कहलाता है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Universal Gates = NAND and NOR; Basic Gates = AND, OR, NOT.

questions.en: The minimum number of NAND gates required to implement Boolean function f = x'y + xy' is(
questions.hi: बूलियन फंक्शन f = x'y + xy' (XOR) को इम्प्लीमेन्ट करने के लिए न्यूनतम कितने NAND गेट चाहिए?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ 💡 • Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Minimum NAND count benchmark: NOT = 1, AND = 2, OR = 3, XOR = 4, XNOR = 5.
